verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a code-first SDK (TypeScript, Python, Go) for writing automations, so it runs programmatically with no interactive UI. It can launch remote Browserbase browsers, local browsers, or attach over CDP, and it can cache agent-discovered workflows into deterministic scripts suited to unattended runs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a headless mode flag, CI pipeline setup guidance or examples, and independent hands-on reports of running it in CI.
